## 2026-09-20 — SLED evidence acquisition and completeness controls

Discovery used three distinct modes: analog searches around settled CaptureBrief/SLED leaders; platform/code searches around PlanetBids and source-family adapters; and obscure operational repositories. Four new candidates were materially inspected.

### eyeteamikey/sled-aggregator — STRONG / MASTER REFERRAL — 29/30
- URL: https://github.com/eyeteamikey/sled-aggregator
- Exact revision: `f04d3a1fb00febe55c139e273207ad491ae24b46`
- Date inspected: 2026-09-20
- Category: Repository / SLED acquisition infrastructure / Business Opportunity
- Concrete capability: Platform-family SLED procurement acquisition plus document-evidence pipeline: canonical opportunities/documents, deterministic dedupe, source/access states, bounded collection, PostgreSQL/Alembic, durable manifest/safe downloader, content-sniffed PDF/DOCX/XLSX/CSV/TSV/text/HTML/XML/RTF/ZIP extraction, targeted OCR, provenance-bearing blocks/tables, and artifact-SHA-256 + parser-version extraction identity. Recent commits separately validate PlanetBids, Bonfire, BidNet Direct, CGI Advantage VSS, DemandStar/OpenBids, Public Purchase and OpenGov tenants.
- Buyer/problem: SLED capture teams and intelligence vendors need broad coverage without confusing scraper failure, restricted documents or partial pagination with a legitimate zero/no-bid result.
- Monetization / first paid wedge: Evidence-grade SLED CaptureBrief tier for 10–20 buyers across 3–4 portal families, reporting source health, packet completeness, hashes, changed documents and unresolved gaps before bid/no-bid.
- Build-time/data advantage: Very high; plausibly 6+ months of platform-family connector, coverage-state, safe-document and provenance engineering compressed.
- Evidence inspected: README architecture/document pipeline; `pyproject.toml`; exact commit history; `docs/connector_validation/planetbids_two_tenants_2026-08-30.md`; coverage-registry/core/report surfaces. The PlanetBids validation proves official agency linkage and public listing/detail behavior while explicitly leaving pagination/background API/document retrieval unproven rather than inventing completeness.
- Actual public license/rights: `pyproject.toml` says `Proprietary`; no root LICENSE found. Under the user's standing assertion, repository-owned public code/content is treated as separately commercially authorized. External portals/APIs/data remain separately governed.
- Reuse classification: High-priority commercial-use candidate under that permission posture; preserve public/read-only limits and per-source access states.
- Score: A5 / B5 / C5 / D5 / E5 / F4 = **29/30**. F reflects external source/tenant access boundaries, not the public-facing proprietary label.
- Combination opportunities: SLED Aggregator -> immutable artifact/hash -> Kingfisher/OCDS -> JSCC quarantine -> Cardinal -> CaptureBrief evidence packet.
- Next action: Make it the reference implementation for the planned 10-agency SLED completeness benchmark and require explicit `verified/fixture_verified/partial/blocked/source_error/restricted/unknown` states.

### slramer/bidsniffer — WATCH — 23/30
- URL: https://github.com/slramer/bidsniffer
- Exact revision: `921c08943644a07aedbec5983270ee29fca9de0e`
- Date inspected: 2026-09-20
- Category: Repository / SLED adapter / Verification component
- Concrete capability: Active PlanetBids/VendorLine public connector with verified-portal registry, bounded HTTP, stable source/detail IDs and current-opportunity parsing.
- Buyer/problem: Regional construction/SLED products can accidentally enable bogus tenants or duplicates when portal discovery relies on search snippets or URL patterns.
- Monetization / first paid wedge: Tenant-verification QA layer ahead of CaptureBrief/PermitPlate SLED collection.
- Build-time/data advantage: Weeks of source-family discovery and false-positive avoidance; weaker than settled leaders for packet/amendment evidence.
- Evidence inspected: README; `src/sources/planetbids.js`; `docs/source-research/planetbids-verification.md`; exact daily-harvest revision. Verification notes document real false-positive tenant discoveries and require agency identity, public search, current records, relevance and non-duplication before promotion.
- Actual public license/rights: No root LICENSE found; user's standing separate commercial permission applies to repo-owned public code/content. Portal data/terms remain separate.
- Reuse classification: Useful QA component, not an evidence authority until raw snapshots/documents/history/completeness states exist.
- Score: A4 / B4 / C3 / D4 / E3 / F5 = **23/30**.
- Combination opportunities: Use its verified-tenant admission gate before SLED Aggregator/Bonfire/OpenGov/PlanetBids production coverage.
- Next action: Port the admission rule platform-neutrally: branding/search hits/route existence alone can never create `production_verified`.

### Shoebn/gecaws — REJECT / DEPRIORITIZED — 18/30
- URL: https://github.com/Shoebn/gecaws
- Exact revision: `32a1943a4347fc9def8565e349eaafe17f31d2fe`
- Date inspected: 2026-09-20
- Evidence/capability: Large older Selenium scraper corpus; safe-inspected PlanetBids code maps title/invitation/stage/scope, estimated value, categories, contacts, line items, awards and attachment URLs.
- Why rejected: Brittle selector-heavy automation, broad exception swallowing, stale 2024 assumptions and no source-health/completeness/provenance contract comparable to current leaders. Sensitive-looking config/upload-property files mentioned by the README were deliberately not opened.
- Actual public license/rights: No root LICENSE found; user's separate permission applies to repo-owned public code/content; external portals remain separate.
- Score: A2 / B3 / C3 / D3 / E2 / F5 = **18/30**.
- Next action: Keep only as an old field/surface taxonomy; do not revisit unless a maintained fork adds tests, source-health and immutable evidence.

### TACH04/ProjectFinder — REJECT / NEGATIVE COMPLETENESS EXAMPLE — 17/30
- URL: https://github.com/TACH04/ProjectFinder
- Exact revision: `148cf332640e56cef69d3024f293278945219d17`
- Date inspected: 2026-09-20
- Evidence/capability: Active multi-source project finder with PlanetBids adapter. Its own `scraper/planetbids.md` explicitly limits collection to the first 30 projects and treats that as adequate coverage.
- Why rejected: A fixed first-page cap can silently omit valid opportunities and can never support a defensible negative finding.
- Actual public license/rights: No root LICENSE found; user's separate permission applies to repo-owned public code/content; source portals remain separate.
- Score: A3 / B3 / C3 / D2 / E2 / F4 = **17/30**.
- Combination lesson / next action: Add a global invariant: fixed page/result caps force `truncated/partial`, never `complete`; no `no opportunity` conclusion may be issued from a capped corpus.

## 2026-09-20 — Official Acquisition.gov agency-supplement namespace expansion

This run followed the official `GSA/GSA-Acquisition-*` family adjacent to settled FAR/DFARS/GSAM leaders. These are distinct agency namespaces, not generic FAR mirrors. Repository activity alone is not proof of substantive rule currency; effective/currentness and class-deviation checks remain separate gates.

### GSA/GSA-Acquisition-EPAAR — STRONG — 28/30
- URL: https://github.com/GSA/GSA-Acquisition-EPAAR
- Exact revision: `b18d63222bcea5ee8c552864bbd6ef4f58d0f62c`
- Date inspected: 2026-09-20
- Category: Official public regulatory source / Agency acquisition supplement
- Concrete capability: Official EPA Acquisition Regulation publication source with structured sections and explicit prescribing relationships; inspected examples include 1516.505 -> 1552.216-72 and 1553-series forms tied to prescribing sections.
- Buyer/problem: EPA bidders need agency-specific provisions/clauses and prescriptions, not FAR-only search.
- Monetization / first paid wedge: EPA solicitation clause reconstruction/readiness diagnostic with exact source, prescription, revision/currentness and deviation uncertainty.
- Build-time/data advantage: High; saves months of supplement ingestion and prescription mapping.
- Evidence inspected: README; exact commit history including substantive January 12, 2026 FY25-closeout update plus June 2026 publication cleanup; official rule files; root LICENSE lookup returned 404.
- Actual public license/rights: No root license found; official GSA federal regulatory publication source. User's standing separate permission applies to repo-owned public code/content; third-party/non-government material remains separate.
- Reuse classification: Authoritative source layer with mandatory effective-date/deviation reconciliation.
- Score: A4 / B4 / C5 / D5 / E5 / F5 = **28/30**.
- Combination opportunities: FAR -> EPAAR -> current EPA deviation -> solicitation packet/amendments -> deterministic evidence gate.
- Next action: Add EPAAR fixtures and verify 10 EPA solicitations against observed clauses/prescriptions/current deviations.
